Third-party browser libraries, copied unmodified from their npm packages (so the site needs no build step and
loads nothing from another host):

- `marked.min.js` — marked 15.0.12, MIT — https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- `purify.min.js` — DOMPurify 3.4.18, MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
